title: 第二十三章 斩妖第二十四章 本源玄精
content_zh:
竹林中传来了怪异嘶吼声，一坨巨大黑影直扑到死猪身上，吭哧吭哧猛啃起来。
无明看那野猪壮硕如牛，满身浓密鬓毛，更看到野猪那一对赤红如火的眸子，还有它一对如同弯刀般长长獠牙。
她晋级八品以后，也跟着师父出去斩妖除魔，对妖物也有一定的认识。
如此巨大猛兽转成的妖物，力量非常强大，普通刀剑很难对野猪造成致命伤害。
被这猪妖一撞，却要骨断筋折。被獠牙挑中，肚子都要被撕裂。
无明尽管心里有所准备，直面如此巨大妖物还是心里发毛。
她一手捏着金光符，一手握剑，本能向着周无纪靠拢过去。
周无纪加持了六阳法眼，能清楚看到无明脸色煞白，杏眼水汪汪的一副柔弱样子，让人不由心生怜惜。
他却退开两步保持距离说道：“我们左右分击，站在一起施展不开。”
“哦。”无明被周无纪说的有些羞又有些气，脸就像发烧了一般，却又不好发作，只能主动和周无纪拉开距离。
法坛上无争放下七星剑，拿起天蓬尺准备施展阴雷，他对无明喝道：“师妹、用金光符把猪妖引过来。”
法坛距离猪妖差不多二十多丈距离，他驾驭的阴雷最远只能到五丈范围。
必须把猪妖引过来，才有机会用阴雷轰杀。
无明应了一声，她深吸了口气默诵法咒，手中真炁运转催发法符。
金光符化作一道金光直飞出十丈多远，轰然化作一团金光照亮了正在进食的猪妖。
猪妖吓了一跳，本能向后一缩退了几步。等到金光消散，它赤红眼珠就看到了不远处无明、周无纪等人。
它才觉醒灵智没多久，却已经知道这样的东西没有威胁，而且肉质软嫩很是好吃。
猪妖怪叫了一声，四蹄发力向着无明就冲了过去。
猪妖越跑越快，它所过之处带起了大片腥风。
无明远远就闻到腥臭之气，熏得她脑子发晕，心里更是慌得不行。

她知道后面还有一众人在看着，作为八品道士，她也不能不战而逃。
无明举着剑还想给猪妖来一下，周无纪看她出剑姿势就知道不太妙。
要说无明剑法也不错，称得上纯熟。只是还做不到炁随剑动。
这样举剑迎着一千多斤的猪妖直刺，最多给猪妖划破点皮肉，无明却要被猪妖撞飞出去，是死是活可就不好说了。
周无纪高声提醒：“快退开！”
无明本就是硬着头皮想要出剑，有周无纪在后面提醒，她也清醒过来，这样迎着猪妖出剑太危险了。
她急忙催发真炁向后脚踩七星罡步，向后疾退。
无明在这门步法上造诣很深，七步连环倒退，速度极快。
躲在法坛后面的众人看不清楚猪妖，只能看到无明杏黄道袍在风中飘扬，衬托她身段婀娜飘逸。
很多人都是无明的倾慕者，还有人出声喝彩。
无明也听到了，她又羞又恼。
猪妖就在前面，她也不敢分神回头，只能心里暗骂：蠢材！
周无纪提醒了无明一句，看到她乖巧退后，也就没释放火铃咒。
这门法术威力不行却胜在能够瞬发，一发火焰轰在猪妖眼睛上，伤不到对方，也足以让它暂时不敢睁眼。
但是，也会对猪妖造成剧烈刺激，不知会引发什么后果，此术不到关键时刻还是不要乱用。
周无纪也跟着向一侧退开，把最中间的法坛露出来。
法坛上无争看到无明脱险，他也松了口气。
让师妹站在前面是让她历练历练，他也没想到师妹如此稚嫩，差点就出事，吓了他一大跳。
无争不敢再等，他调整了气息猛然厉喝：“妖孽、还不受死！”
这一嗓子中气十足，立即吸引了猪妖的注意。

猪妖赤红眼珠盯着无争，四蹄刨地向着法坛直冲过去。
无争这会还很冷静，他举起天蓬尺指着猪妖，计算着猪妖的速度和距离。
眼看着猪妖四蹄发力就要跳上法坛了，无争才一声低喝：“天蓬天蓬，号令雷霆、急急如北帝敕令！”
催发阴雷需要繁琐仪轨已经提前准备好，无争快速诵咒后直接催发了阴雷。
一道如水般半透明电光闪了下，就直接没入猪妖身体。
content_en:
A strange roar came from the bamboo forest, and a huge black shadow pounced on the dead pig and began to chew fiercely.
Wuming saw that the wild boar was as strong as an ox and covered with thick hair on the temples. He also saw the wild boar's red eyes, as well as its long tusks like scimitars.
After she advanced to the eighth level, she followed her master to slay demons and had a certain understanding of monsters.
The monster transformed from such a huge beast is very powerful, and it is difficult for ordinary swords to cause fatal damage to the wild boar.
Being hit by this pig demon will break your bones and tendons. If picked by the fangs, the stomach will be torn apart.
Although Wu Ming was prepared in his heart, he still felt frightened when facing such a huge monster.
Holding the golden talisman in one hand and holding the sword in the other, she instinctively moved closer to Zhou Wuji.
Zhou Wuji had been blessed with the Six Yang Dharma Eyes, and could clearly see Wu Ming's pale face and watery almond-shaped eyes, which made people feel pity for him.
But he took two steps back to keep his distance and said: "We attack separately from the left and right, but we can't do it while standing together."
"Oh." Wu Ming was a little embarrassed and angry when Zhou Wuji said it. His face felt like he had a fever, but he couldn't get it, so he could only take the initiative to distance himself from Zhou Wuji.
Wu Zheng put down the Seven-Star Sword on the altar, picked up the Canopy Ruler and prepared to use the Yin Thunder. He shouted to Wu Ming: "Junior Sister, use the Golden Light Talisman to lure the pig demon over."
The altar is almost twenty feet away from the pig demon, and the furthest Yin Thunder he controls can only reach five feet.
You must lure the pig demon over to have a chance to kill it with Yin Thunder.
Wu Ming responded, she took a deep breath and recited the mantra silently, and the true energy in her hand circulated to activate the talisman.
The golden light talisman turned into a golden light and flew more than ten feet away. It suddenly turned into a ball of golden light and illuminated the pig demon who was eating.
The pig demon was startled and instinctively took a few steps back. When the golden light dissipated, its red eyes saw Wuming, Zhou Wuji and others not far away.
It has only awakened its intelligence not long ago, but it already knows that such things are not threatening, and the meat is tender and delicious.
The pig monster screamed, and rushed towards Wuming with all its hooves.
The pig demon ran faster and faster, causing a large fishy wind wherever it passed.
Wu Ming could smell the fishy smell from afar, which made her head dizzy and her heart even more panicked.
She knew there were people watching from behind, and as an eighth-grade Taoist priest, she couldn't escape without a fight.
Wuming raised his sword and wanted to hit the pig demon, but Zhou Wuji knew that something was wrong when he saw the way she drew the sword.
Wu Ming's swordsmanship is also good and can be called proficient. It's just that I can't move Qi with the sword yet.
He raised his sword like this and stabbed the pig demon, which weighed more than a thousand kilograms. At most, the pig demon's flesh was scratched, but Wu Ming was knocked out by the pig demon. It was hard to say whether he would live or die.
Zhou Wuji reminded loudly: "Get out of the way!"
Wu Ming was determined to draw the sword, but Zhou Wuji reminded her from behind and she woke up. It would be too dangerous to draw the sword against the pig demon.
She hurriedly activated her true energy and stepped backwards on the Seven Star Steps, retreating quickly.
Wuming was very accomplished in this footwork, and he walked backwards in a series of seven steps at an extremely fast speed.
The people hiding behind the altar couldn't see the pig demon clearly, and could only see Wuming's apricot robe fluttering in the wind, highlighting her graceful and elegant figure.
Many people were admirers of ignorance, and some cheered loudly.
Wu Ming also heard it, and she was ashamed and annoyed.
The pig demon was right in front of her, and she didn't dare to turn around while she was distracted. She could only curse in her mind: Idiot!
Zhou Wuji reminded Wu Ming, and when he saw her obediently retreating, he did not release the Fire Bell Curse.
This spell is not very powerful, but it is better than it can be cast instantly. A burst of flames hits the pig demon's eyes, which cannot hurt the opponent, but is enough to make it dare not open its eyes temporarily.
However, it will also cause severe stimulation to the pig demon. I don’t know what the consequences will be. It is better not to use this technique indiscriminately until the critical moment.
Zhou Wuji also stepped away to one side, exposing the altar in the middle.
On the Dharma altar, Wu Zheng saw that Wu Ming was out of danger, and he was relieved.Take a breath.
Letting the junior sister stand in front was to let her practice. He didn't expect that the junior sister was so immature and almost had an accident, which shocked him.
Wu Zheng didn't dare to wait any longer. He adjusted his breath and shouted suddenly: "You monster, don't die yet!"
This voice was full of energy and immediately attracted the attention of the pig demon.
The pig demon's red eyes stared at Wu Zheng, and he rushed toward the altar with his hooves.
Wu Zheng was still calm at the moment. He raised the canopy ruler and pointed it at the pig demon, calculating the speed and distance of the pig demon.
Seeing that the pig demon was about to jump onto the altar with all its hooves, Wu Zheng shouted: "Canopy, canopy, command thunder, be as hasty as the Northern Emperor's order!"
The complicated rituals required to activate the Yin Thunder were prepared in advance. Wu Zheng quickly recited the incantation and directly activated the Yin Thunder.
A translucent electric light like water flashed and sank directly into the pig demon's body.
